Once a year, God leaves his temple, because his little sister asked. As the story goes, in Puri, Subhadra looked out of the temple and said, brothers, I want to see the city.
So Jagannath and Balabhadra built three giant chariots. One for each of them. Sixteen wheels for Jagannath. Fourteen for Balabhadra. Twelve for Subhadra.
Wait, who pulls them? Not horses. Not kings. Us. Lakhs of people pull the ropes together. And even the king sweeps the road in front of the chariots with a golden broom.
That's why we celebrate Rath Yatra. Once a year, God comes out to see his people, and anyone can touch the rope. Comment Jai Jagannath if you have pulled the rope.
